meta.description: Other small, free tools from the maker of OpenScreenShot: Minimalist Notes, a quiet place to think, and Musing, a new tab with a quote worth keeping.

label: Also by @PGHQdev
heading: Cool stuff
lead: Small tools from the same hands as OpenScreenShot. Each one is free, private, and made to do one thing well.

tools.name: Minimalist Notes
tools.body: Open the page and write. Your notes are saved on your device, work offline, and need no account. There is nothing to set up and nothing to pay for.

tools.name: Musing
tools.tag: Let the wisdom of the past guide your present.
tools.body: A new tab that meets you with a quote worth keeping — matched to what you have been thinking about, analyzed on your device. Nothing is sent to a server.

thanks: All of these are given away whole. If you want to give something back, a coffee is plenty.
